baseline_evidence_review.scope: Colab arrays checked with pinned local engine; exact masks and class decisions; probability differences recorded without requiring bitwise equality; no new attacks

inloop_evidence_review.scope: Exported final-stage vectors independently checked/rescored; intermediate logs and digests checked for consistency, not independent reconstruction of every intermediate vector

aggregate_diagnostic.rule: sum > 0 and max == 0, exact native stored values, in 108 duration/bytes_out/pkts_out pairs
aggregate_diagnostic.assumption: Each named sum/max pair summarizes the same observations; verify feature-extractor semantics before making a traffic-level claim.
aggregate_diagnostic.limitations: This is one necessary-condition diagnostic, not a complete feasibility test. Unflagged vectors are not established as realizable or malicious. Counts across seeds/methods reuse the same originals.

reproduction_comparison.scope: Hash comparison covers final representative NPZ archives and selected input archive; does not compare all intermediate generations or every raw stage file.

limitations: Simple rollback inside existing evolutionary search, not a novelty or optimality claim.
Repair may collapse many offspring to clean or duplicate vectors; all evaluations still count.
The compatibility scaler uses all feature rows and inherits frozen checkpoint training history.
Development records and repeated attack seeds are not independent final test observations.
The baseline end-only methods reuse one attack run; in-loop methods generate new trajectories.
Union-with-original results require both attacks and are not an equal-total-compute comparison.
Valid aggregate features do not prove packet realizability or retained malicious functionality.
Three of four additional-evasion occurrences have positive sums with zero corresponding maxima; two original records are reused across these occurrences.
The diagnostic assumes paired statistics summarize the same observations. Extractor semantics, packet realizability and retained attack function were not established.
No new acceptance rule was used to alter official attack results.
Saved final-stage vectors and representatives were checked independently; intermediate generation digests/counters were checked only for consistency.
Reproducing final representative archives does not establish cross-machine determinism for every internal trajectory or future run.
No new IDS training or full-dataset accuracy/false-positive evaluation was performed.
